evidence.title: Controlled ASME B31.3-2024 source
evidence.acceptance: Exact edition, secure source identity, document SHA-256 and invocation/applicability locators independently verified

evidence.title: Controlled ASME VIII-3-2025 source
evidence.acceptance: Exact secure source bytes/hash reconciled and KD-3/KD320 method locators independently verified

evidence.title: KD320 semantic extraction sheet
evidence.acceptance: Every required semantic item extracted with exact locator, units, sign/selection/applicability rules and no hidden default

evidence.title: Stress and mean-stress definitions
evidence.acceptance: Stress selection, associated mean quantity, sign convention and compression/zero branch are independently established

evidence.title: Mean-stress correction parameter custody
evidence.acceptance: Every correction parameter, material dependency, limit and failure rule is independently established

evidence.title: Fatigue-curve custody
evidence.acceptance: Applicable curve identity, scope, endpoint/interpolation/extrapolation rules and permissible-cycle semantics independently verified

evidence.title: Material and temperature rules
evidence.acceptance: All controlled material properties and temperature-selection/interpolation rules required by the method are established

evidence.title: Applicability envelope
evidence.acceptance: Qualified geometry, wall state, loading, material/environment and explicit exclusions are independently established

evidence.title: Independent numerical oracle set
evidence.acceptance: Native benchmark cases receive frozen independent expected values only after Q1 controlled semantics are independently checked

evidence.title: Negative and fail-closed tests
evidence.acceptance: All controlled invalid, missing, ambiguous, edition, applicability and curve-boundary conditions block deterministically

evidence.title: Independent checker
evidence.acceptance: Source extraction, method contract, oracle admission and implementation are reviewed by a checker independent of the implementer

evidence.title: Release authorization
evidence.acceptance: Separate owner/release-authority decision after method and software qualification; no automatic promotion

q1ExitCriteria.effectOnExit: Q2 may populate independently sourced native oracle expectations; production native KD320 remains prohibited
